items.caption: A modern drawing of 機 in small-seal style. Shuowen analyzes the graph as 木 with 幾 supplying its sound.
items.alt: Black line drawing of the small-seal form 機, with 木 on the left and 幾 on the right.
items.selection_reason: This identified seal-style drawing illustrates the traditional graph discussed in the entry and its recorded component analysis, without presenting the image as an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw of a seal-style form, not an excavated inscription or facsimile. The evidence does not establish earlier oracle-bone or bronze forms, or a graphic development sequence for 機.
